create_dotdict_with_dot_access: create a dotdict that supports dot notation access for dictionary values and merging
update_dotdict_with_type_conversion: update a dotdict with automatic type conversion between torch tensors and numpy arrays
convert_python_type_to_torch_dtype: convert a Python or numpy type to its corresponding torch dtype using type_to_torch_dtype
create_default_dotdict_with_auto_init: create a default_dotdict that auto-initializes missing keys with a specified default type
convert_dotdict_to_plain_dict: convert a nested dotdict back to a plain Python dictionary using the to_dict method
